about: C1c System presentations (PLAN §1.6, §1.7 rows 'Menus, popovers, dropdown slabs', 'Alerts', 'Sheets'; §1.8; WN §5.1-§5.4). Default profile: every menu slab, alert card and sheet is one +10 mm non-interactive crop over a thick slab, rising 0 -> +10 with the materialize (P7's default 'from'); modal: true, so while one is open only these pop (admission rule 6) and every other in-page pop drops (the source card included, D6b).

Click-safe: menu rows are 64 px elements (60 visible), Cancel 60, alert buttons 60, the sheet close circle 60: s >= 52 admits +10. A sheet holding smaller focusables is capped below 10 by the reporter and stays flat (safe).

Destructive confirmations never pop (rule 4): C1c's runtime tags the red button data-lgs-destructive and the card data-lgs-plate="thick", so native mode draws that alert as one flat thick plate (PLAN-1c-1). 'exclude' also keeps Steam's own .DialogButton.Destructive cards down if the tag is late.
Windowless routes (no cover): the runtime also makes the menu slab / alert / sheet card a thick plate (C2a REQ #3), so the crop is covered (rule 1) and its plate becomes the occluder under it.
hole fill 'auto': off axis, the sliver under the crop takes the tones around it (posters beside the tile menu, the .35 scrim around alerts and sheets, PLAN §1.8).

Behind wp.c1c (the tags come from the runtime); the legacy 'menu', 'sheet', 'sheet-panel', 'filters' and 'button' rules are retired only while it is on ('button' lifted a focused DialogButton 1.84 mm, a depth outside PLAN §1.7's set, and popped the red button of a destructive confirmation: sgcheck R2/R4 at 09:57; in-window controls stay at 0). Wearer profile (interactivePops): +30, interactive.
